what: Math Practice is a fast drill tool for times tables and mental arithmetic. You choose what to practise, answer one question at a time, and get instant feedback on every answer.

Practise any of the times tables from 1 to 20, or mix addition, subtraction, multiplication and division at three difficulty levels. Play a set number of questions or race the clock for 1, 2 or 5 minutes.

It suits primary school children learning their tables, older students sharpening mental maths before an exam, and adults who want to keep their arithmetic quick. A large on-screen number pad makes it easy to use on a phone or tablet.
uses: Focus on the tables a child finds hard, such as 7, 8 and 12, until the answers come instantly.
Use 1 minute rounds and try to beat your best score.
Print a sheet of 30 to 90 problems with an answer key on a separate page.
Do a quick round of mixed questions before a maths test.
Retry the questions you got wrong until they stick.
tutorial: Click Times tables and tap the tables you want, or use All, 2 to 12 or None. For mixed practice, click Mixed + − × ÷ and choose the operations.

For times tables, choose the largest number to multiply by: 10, 12 or 20, and whether to include division facts. For mixed practice, choose Easy (single digits), Medium (two digits) or Hard (three digits).
Pick 10, 20 or 50 questions, or a timed round of 1, 2 or 5 minutes.
Click Start practice. Type the answer with your keyboard or the on-screen pad and press Enter or Check. A green border means right. A red border shows the correct answer before the next question.
At the end you see how many were correct, your accuracy, the time and the average time per question. A new best score is celebrated.
Click Retry my mistakes to answer only the questions you missed.
Choose a worksheet size and click Print worksheet with answers for a fresh set of problems using your current settings.
features: Pick any mix of times tables, up to × 20.
Addition, subtraction, multiplication and whole-number division.
From single digits up to three-digit numbers.
Race the clock or answer a set number of questions.
See straight away if you were right, and the correct answer if not.
Your record is saved for each set of settings.
Large buttons replace the phone keyboard on touch screens.
With an answer key on its own page.

example.title: Example: a 1 minute times tables challenge
example.text: Select the 6, 7 and 8 times tables, multiply up to 12, and choose 1 minute. Click Start practice. The first question is 7 × 8 = ?. You type 56 and press Enter; the box turns green and the next question appears. You type 42 for 6 × 8 by mistake, and the tool shows "6 × 8 = 48" in red. When time runs out you see 23 / 24 correct, 96% accuracy and 2.5 s per question, and "6 × 8 = 48 (you wrote 42)" in the mistakes list.

tips: Start with untimed rounds of 10 questions, then move to timed rounds once you are accurate.
Practise a few tables at a time instead of all of them at once.
Use Retry my mistakes straight after each round while the answers are fresh.
Print a worksheet for practice away from screens.
For mental addition, add the tens first, then the ones: 47 + 38 is 70 + 15.
problems: It says choose at least one times table
No table is selected. Tap a number or click 2 to 12.
The phone keyboard does not appear
That is on purpose. On touch screens, use the on-screen number pad below the question.
How do I type a negative answer?
Press the − key on the pad, or type a minus sign. Negative answers only appear if you choose Can be negative for subtraction.
My best score was not saved
Best scores are only saved for complete rounds that are not mistake retries, and only in this browser.
